designationHistory.name: Nine-Pipe Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Warren G. Harding set aside the Nine-Pipe reservoir site on the Flathead Irrigation Project, Montana, as the Nine-Pipe Reservation, a refuge and breeding ground for native birds, by Executive Order 3503.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Nine-Pipe Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by EO 8145 (May 31, 1939) and Nine-Pipe National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (1940). The Presidency Project has no page for EO 3503 itself; it is cited in EO 8145. Lands lie within the Flathead Indian Reservation; flag any copy about that for the Library's human reviewers.
